name: pharma-visit-system
description: 医药代表拜访管理系统

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && nohup npm run dev > ../frontend.log 2>&1 &
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && nohup npm run dev > ../backend.log 2>&1 &
scripts.start: npm run start:backend && sleep 3 && npm run start:frontend
